text:
maria: Heads-up — we're getting repeated scale-ups then immediate scale-downs in Dedicated pool eu-west-2-prod-42. Customer requests start 429ing during the churn. Seen ~6 up/down cycles in 9m, mostly around 14:12-14:21 UTC.

sre-oncall-bot: ALERT: dedicated-pool-eu-west-2-prod-42: scale-pulse detected (high churn rate).

jon: Can you paste the autoscaler config and a short flame/graph link? curious about cooldown and metric window.

maria: Grafana panels: https://grafana.redwood/in/dedicated/pool-42 (quick view)
Logs snippet:```
2026-03-16T14:13:12Z  scale-trigger: queued_requests=78 cpu=42%
2026-03-16T14:13:23Z  scale-up start -> new-replicas=2
2026-03-16T14:13:36Z  api: 429 from router -> tenant=brightcart
2026-03-16T14:13:43Z  scale-down start -> replicas=1
```
Config excerpt:```yaml
autoscaler: 
  metric: queued_requests
  threshold_up: 60
  threshold_down: 20
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  smoothing_window_seconds: 30
```

metrics-bot: panel snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/snapshot/abc123 (spiky queued_requests, 1min resolution)

kevin: brightcart was using a large batched inference job earlier; saw sudden KV cache miss rate jump that can temporarily increase upstream latency. Could be a noisy-tenant cache warm/cold effect causing transient queue spikes.

lia: Two quick ideas: (1) increase cooldown_seconds to avoid flipping for short-lived spikes (try 120s), (2) switch autoscaler metric to a moving-average over 1-2m rather than instant queued_requests. smoothing_window_seconds 30 -> 90.

jon: Agreed. Also add a minimum-stable-period after scale-up to keep new replicas available for warmup (we don't want immediate scale-down while KV warmed). Something like: stable_after_seconds: 90.

maria: Repro steps I can run in staging: 1) replay brightcart load trace (burst pattern) 2) force cache invalidation on pool-42 3) watch queued_requests and replicas. Will run in 30m.

kevin: Doing a quick probe on staging now with replay tool. command: ```./tools/replay --trace brightcart-burst.json --pool eu-west-2-prod-42 --duration 8m```

kevin: Update — replayed 8m burst. With current cooldown=60s we still saw scale->shrink within ~70s because the queued_requests dropped after cache warmed. CPU stayed modest but requests queue oscillated. Bumped cooldown to 120s and smoothing to 90s in staging config; re-ran replay -> single scale-up and stable. 429s dropped to zero during second run.

lia: Nice. Can you paste the exact patch used so I can roll to prod? Also we should add a note to runbook about noisy-tenant indicators (cache-miss rate > 50% + queued_requests spike).

kevin: Patch:```yaml
autoscaler:
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  smoothing_window_seconds: 90
  stable_after_seconds: 90
```
Applied to staging namespace: infra-dedicated-staging, commit hash: a1b2c3d

maria: I'll schedule a short prod rollout: canary 5% 10m, then 50% 20m, then full if no regressions. I'll also open a support ticket with brightcart to ask about batching behavior.

jon: Also add a Grafana alert for "rapid scale churn" (>=3 scale events within 10m) that tags the tenant if possible.

maria: Created runbook entry and PR: https://git.redwood/infra/runbooks/pulse-autoscale-guardrail.md (will add thresholds + run steps).

sre-oncall-bot: NOTE: On-call rotation updated: kevin assigned to follow-up for 24h. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks everyone — marking this thread for postmortem notes and closing once prod canary is healthy.

jon: :thumbsup:
